Illust. by Lauren† Laba† [ flickr http://bit.ly/wQZeY2 ]

:Tracklisting Story:

Tonight I'm gonna have myself a real good time. I'm gonna call some family and friends and we'll be chopping some green onions all night, like everyday. 

In the meantime, like everyday, I'll be howlin' for you, like a lonely boy.

One day though, I'll put on my Fred Astaire look and go out, young, wild & free untill 5 o'clock in the morning, sharing the L-O-V-E that's haunting my midnight life. I'll be the 8th Wonder, I'll be able to say "I AM SOMEBODY", to stunt like my daddy in 1901, wearing Gucci and eating 212 french fries 'pon the floor (It takes a lot of stamina to do that !)

I've been writing to her for years and years now but she doesn't mind. I follow rivers and she hops from one big jet plane to another, from one bizness trip to another... and she always seems far nearer than she really is

I'll try to contact her again, I'll keep hanging on and I'll try to send some good vibrations.

Je passe de la musique pour tous 
et du coup
Personne ne peut vraiment écouter ça.

J’essaie de résoudre le grand puzzle composé de toutes les chansons du monde à grand coup de mashup et de saucisonnage de chansons

Dans cette émission, pour ta pénitence, tu écouteras du rock, du rap, du métal, de l’electro, de la salsa, 
de la soul de la funk, 
de la pop et du punk 

Je vous emmène au Liban, en Jamaïque, 
en France et en Angleterre, 
aux USA et à Cuba, 
Sur La planète mars et au tréfonds de la galaxie 
Au pays des merveilles si tu peux attraper le lapin
50 chansons par heure et aucune en entier
Pas de doute
C’est signé ! fabuleuxfab inzemix !

les musiques du monde, tout un monde de musiques ce soir dans le béarn et au rajahstan .

shows.description:
Ce soir la fabrock  s02e11 est entièrement consacrée Nosfell. 1 heure pour découvrir Nosfell, à travers des extraits de son nouvel album, de ses albums précédents mais également de ses coups de coeur musicaux notamment :
Dominique A et Dick Annegarn qui ont écrit des textes pour cet album, 
Joni Mitchell, 
Neil Young, 
Michael Jackson 
ou Elton John.

Pour mettre ces chansons en perspective, des extraits de l'entretien que Nosfell nous avait accordé lors de son passage au BBC à Hérouville : 
de la voix, 
de ses projets, 
de ses collaborations avec le chorégraphe Philippe Decouflé, 
du poids de la culture, 
de sa langue et de pourquoi il l'a laissée de côté sur cet album, 
des chansons amoureuses, 
de Jeff Buckley et de son père, 
de ses destinations préférés, 
de ses radios préférées.

Illustration : Béa Gillot (https://www.facebook.com/pages/B%C3%A9a-Gillot-Photographies/610164715759868)

Et oui ce soir on commence avec du gros métal qui tâche
Le nouveau Megadeth suivi d'un des meilleurs albums de 2015 j'ai nommé Periphery
Puis ce sera une déferlante de brulots hip-hop, neo soul, trap, funk, bogaloo, jazz, electro
Pour les noms ce sera nouveau Breakbot, Massive Animal Collective, Kool Keith, Currensy, Rihanna, Birdy Nam Nam, Dj Shadow, Asap Ferg
Ce soir on t'emmène au zaire, dans la jungle, en australie, en soucoupe volante, en Floride, à puerto rico, dans le passé, à Kinshasa, à Beverly Hills, à Woodstock et même en France
Avec des interventions de Mohamed Ali, Spike Lee, Don King, Tintin et Alice,
Des reprises, des remix, pas de mashup mais un hommage au labcabincalifornia des Pharcyde qui fetait ses 20 ans en 2015

L'occasion pour La fabrock de rencontrer les 3 djs Crazy B, Lil Mike et DJ Need qui ont décidé de poursuivre l'aventure BNN après le départ de Dj Pone.

shows.name: La fabrock | Guestmix for The Global Glitch on Mi Soul Radio (London, UK) | 20160308
shows.description:
A 40 minutes handcrafted for the Global Glitch radio show on Mi Soul Radio.

shows.name: S04e16 | Tell Me Sutra | 2nd of February 2016
shows.description:
This is the last episode in the funk-soul-jazz-world section, next week we'll be back with an all electronic show. So enjoy this one ! 

It's full of the gems I collected over the last few months : James Brown, Gregory Isaacs for the big names, a lot of jazz standards revisited (Mona Lisa, Summertime, Nuages), and all the smoothness that can bring some piano, saxophone or double bass virtuoso solos.

Smooth but not cold as we warm things up with some carribean reggae niceness, wild afrofunk, psychedelic samba, and a famous massive attack sample hidden somewhere.

Compilation of the month : Doing It in Lagos: Boogie, Pop & Disco in 1980s Nigeria https://www.soundwayrecords.com/Shop/DownloadDetails?rid=SWR_RE_116

The show finishes with a reinterpretation of Philip Glass by Bruce Levingston featuring a sutra/poem reading by Ethan Hawke.

Meditate, drink beer, shit in your neighbour's garden, and do the rock. Respectfully.

shows.description:
Original post : ptitbazar-free-legal.blogspot....el/La%20Fabrock
F&L sur FB: facebook.com/ptitbazargratuitetlegal

Fredy High est défoncé, tchèque et il y a 6 mois il était très content d'avoir 1000 followers sur Soundcloud alors il nous a fait ce petit cadeau qui sent bon la sensi. 
En parlant de weed, Father Funk vient réclamer sa part: après nous avoir inondés de remix surfunkys pendant des mois, il propose enfin ses propres beats et sa part en D&B ensoleillé. 
Vous avez dit soleil ? Direction Montpellier avec ce remix des Beastie signé Mr Ours, ou Perth en Australie avec un remix parmi des dizaines en free DL sur le Soundcloud de Casual Connection souvent des version nu-disco de classiques du funk ou du hip-hop. 
TQC c'est un producteur de Kiev en Ukraine qui a quelques free DL pour ces remix de Jeru, Nas ou MF Doom et ici un beat juggling sur un classique de Jimi Hendrix. 
Mo Laudi c'est du Made in Paris qui remixe du Made in Brasil ! 
Ronny Hammond ça vient des Pays-Bas par le nom et haut par la défonce. 
Enfin, Lege Kale ça vient d'Ohio aux US, un producteur qui a pas pu choisir entre trap, jazz, blues, r&b et electro mais on lui en veut pas. Morceau cadeau pour ces 20 000 followers sur Soundcloud.

shows.name: Topspin #07 - Spacy Musical Ping-Pong with Gelale
shows.description:
After these couple of years following Gelale as a fan and collaborator, (https://www.mixcloud.com/lafabrock/playlists/la-fabrock-gelales-funky-explorations/), the only explanation I have for his genius is that he is otherworldly. 

When his funklecticity collides with my total lack of musical boundaries that means you need to suit up for a stellar journey into sound, 

jumping from the still earth of Bernard Hermann 
to the exoplanet of The Weeknd 
partying with Foo X-Fighters, 
heading to the Aloé Blacc Star, 
invading 90's abstract french rap 
grounding in world beats,  
and reaching out for hybrids of jazz. 

<3 https://www.mixcloud.com/Gelale/
__________________________
On part avec Gelale à travers la galaxie à la recherche de la grande question que nous nous posons tous : mais pourquoi est-il si Génial ? Seule explication possible : une origine extra-terrestre, en enfant sauvé du péril d'une civilisation avancée et envoyé sur terre pour répandre l'amour et le funk.

I don't know much about ambient or illbient though I really enjoy listening to records from these genre, so I racked my brain trying to think back of all the artists or songs that had strange sounds. shows.name: [Human] A Day in The Hi-Life
shows.description:
Follow Jellylegs on mixcloud : mixcloud.com/gazhughes1
This mix on mixcloud : mixcloud.com/gazhughes1/human-...with-la-fabrock
HUMAN ? What is it to be human ? What makes me, as a radio dj, Human ? Emotions obviously. The old Man Vs Machine dichotomy. Also maybe the ability to pick songs for personnal reasons, the joy of not being an algorithm, not being programmed, being free to play only the intro of the song, or the last note, to chop it, loop it, mix it with another song, have someone in mind when picking it and hope they'll listen to it.
For this mix, I tried to:

go back to my early and most intense musical findings,
using my memory first and then digging into my physical record collection,
picking early recordings by the artists that were most influential in my life,
either because they are the music of my generation (Aphex Twin, Four Tet, Deadelus, Dj Shadow, The Chemical Brothers, Basement Jaxx, Beastie Boys),
because my father played all the time (Santana, Dire Straits, The Beatles, Supertramp),
because I'm proud of French culture (Serge Gainsbourg, Mr Oizo, Daft Punk)
and open to the World (Brasil, Calypso).
over the years, my favourite way to discover music was to find the original samples of songs I liked (Patti Page, Diana Ross, Carrie Lucas).
I've shyed away from playing too much rock or metal for fear of antagonizing listeners over my passion for Suicidal Tendancies, Faith No More or Iron Maiden and kept only a classic Motorhead.

I'll galdly admit the mix is weird but ain't that what makes us human above all ? It's personal, can it be universal ?

UnNumeroCualquiera then sent some electro ambient mix with 90's electronic music vibe : Dj SPooky, Bola, Boards Of Canada, I-F, etc. I had to research those bands and dig back in my own collection. 

I found similar artists (Luke Vibert, FunkStorüng, Aphex Twin, The Orb), artists that might have inspired (Kraftwerk, Eno, Jarre) or shaped that 90's sound as well as their legacy (113, Gessafelstein, Burial) up to the latest releases (Aesop Rock and Tobacco, Lotic, Richard Devine). 

The result is a 1h15 min electro ambient nostalgia mix that verges on ambient, IDM, abstract, experimental and hip-hop with tracks from 1977 to 2019.

There's nothing quite like making music with the people you love. Especially when they are as kind and gifted with the sweetest musical taste as Magda Brand. 

For us Mixcloud people, making music together means sending over bits of mixes that we can thread on and craft to reflect our moods and dig on topics we chose to investigate.

Magda and I share the opinion that there isn't enough room for modern classical music on Mixcloud (please prove us wrong) so we decided to work on those Delitiae Musicae mixes where we explore the friction points between classical and modern music.

In this mix, you'll hear piano, guitar, strings, oboe, accordion, voices, MPCs and all the notes that dwell in our hearts and ears within the realms of Jazz, Soul, Classical, Rap, Ambient and more.

shows.description:
Starting off with Lang Lang playing around with "Chopsticks" (remember Marilyn Monroe in 1955's Billy Wilder's classic Seven Year Itch ?)
* this mix escalates quickly to higher level of virtuosity with 
* new releases from Vansessa Wagner taking on Philip Glass, 
* Olga Scheps bringing thunder out of her pianoforte 
* and Yu-Chien Tseng, the 10 M$ violin player, playing the most technical Wieniawski piece on a 7 M$ Guarneri Del Gesù violin.
* Before the end of the show, more Lang Lang, more Wanessa Wagner, 
* Jazz piano with Sun Ra, 
* OST from Max Richeter and Johann Johannsson and Ken Thorne, 
* Bach with a piece for organ by Olivier Latry, and the Goldberg Variations by legendary Glenn Gould, 
* sweetness with Guillaume Coppola taking on a Debussy favourite, 
* more violin virtuosity with South Korean young talent Sueye Park 
* ending with some Sitar by Bill Laswell.

Hoping to soothe your hearts and ears, lafabrock wishing you a fluffy early June.

shows.name: Delitiae Musicae 4 (Classical meets Modern) with Magda Brand
shows.description:
Fab says:
Classical is the new black. With these series Magda and I aim to shed a new light on classical music, explore the collision of old and new, the friction of modernity and tradition, offer a path to explore new takes on classical pieces, study how new artists deconstruct and reinvent, blur the lines, pay tribute to their forefathers and ultimately make the music of today with the sounds of yesterday and vice versa.

Magda Says : 
Mozart said once: "there is nothing that music cannot do, as long as it remains music". I think I understood the meaning of those words the first time I heard Emerson, Lake and Palmer's "Pictures at an Exhibition". Contemporary classical music has much to offer: that's a good reason to feel excited about the big potential of this series, which Fab and myself curate with deep love for the music and great respect for the artists. I hope we can enthrall you with our selections without borders.

For the last 4 years I behaved myself and try to keep it genre coherent.

A great opportunity for me to dig back in my library and basically expose the very own musical mess that's inside my head and guts.

shows.name: Death Of A Villain | Vol. 1 | Madvillain, NerhuvianDOOM, DANGERDOOM, Czarface, Jay Electronica, J Di
shows.description:
On the 31st of December 2020 the rap world was shook to learn about the death of one of the most respected underground rapper of the last 2 decades, Daniel Dumile, AKA DOOM, METAL FACE or MF DOOM (All caps when you spell the name).

Often described as "your favorite rappers favorite rapper", he leaves behind an impressive discography. Appart from the seminal album Madvillainy, in collaboration with Madlib, he will be remembered for his collaborations with a wide array of producers and rappers including Danger Mouse (DANGERDOOM), Jneiro Jarel (JJ DOOM), Czarface, Bishop Nerhu, Ghostface but also Gorillaz, Radiohead's Thom Yorke, Prince Paul, J Dilla, The Avalanches, Tuxedo or BADBADNOTGOOD.

A series of 3 mixes compiling my favourite joints and celebrating the power of his rhyming, mad producing skills, and the genius of his musical choices.

shows.name: S08e09 | Daft Punk | Chronologic
shows.description:
This is a retrospective of Daft Punk's main singles as drawn from their 4 studio albums 📀. 

Two weeks ago on the 22nd of february, the duo announced that they decided to put an end to the Daft Punk project 🪓. 

I spent the following weeks 
- listening to their albums🎧, 
- re-watching the excellent BBC documentary Daft Punk Unchained 🔓 (https://vimeo.com/322498698), 
- showing Interstella 5555 🧞‍♀️ to my kids 
- and laughing at Michel Gondry original pitch for the Around The World video 🌍(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mZDzDfg7roM). 

And also, trying to figure out a way to put a mix together. 

The main problem being that they already made the ultimate Daft Punk mix in the form of Alive 2007 🙌 and that I clearly don't have enough LED 🔦 to replicate something that good. 

Instead, here's an humble chronological retrospective of their career. 

Thank you robots. And all the artists involved. 
----

Songs in here range from 1963 to 2023 with a heavy focus on the 2006>2011 span. Go to comments to see those songs ranked by released date.

- Ottawan was a band produced by Thomas Bangalter's (half daf punk) father
- I saw a video of Manu Chao playing that remix of his song on a DJ set. Wasn't ready.
- That final skit in the Skyy song is so cute

It was supposed to be just one mix by Julian but the selection grew on me and I felt like mixing it. Before I knew it, I was digging deep in my vaults, adding personal favorites, as well as classic house anthems, and spending way too much time crafting the mix.

The result is this 46 songs in 90 minutes mix covering 4 decades of house music (1992-2024). 
Whether you like acid, jazz, latin, hip-hop, french filtered, disco, synthetic, pop, bass, or even live-band.
We provide originals, rares, remixes, overheard classics, hidden gems, famous samples you name it.

All the love goes out to the artist and the dancers.

And to Julian for reigniting the house fire in me !

Welcome to our house !

shows.description:
Et vous vous avez écouté quoi cette année 2024 ? C'est sûr qu'il y avait le choix !
Alors c'est toujours sympa de retrouver ses tontons ( @lafabrock @louiegourmande) pour croiser les jets et voir ce qui surnage. 
Pas d'invités cette année mais une élection de nos 70 morceaux préférés qu'on vous livre mijotés puis passés à la moulinette et servis directement en intraveineuse. J'aurais tout pu détailler ici mais franchement… la musique parle d'elle même.
Jetons ensemble une dernière pelleté de terre sur le cercueil encore fumant de 2024. Les tontons transistors tout endimanchés font le service.

Every year since 2017 les tontons transistors get together to chose their favorite tracks of the past year and mash them all up in 2 epic mixes to ease you into the new year. 
Thanks to al the artists and labels. 
Share the music, spread the love ❤️.

Here's mix A.
and there's mix B (coming soon).

Previous years : https://www.mixcloud.com/lafabrock/playlists/les-tontons-transistors-best-of/
